newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU says reviews BA takeover of Air Liberte.
newsitem.headline: EU says reviews BA takeover of Air Liberte.

text.p: The European Commission said on Tuesday it was starting a routine probe into the acquisition of French airline company Air Liberte by British Airways.

It said in a notice to be published in the European Union's Official Journal that the deal was submitted for clearance under the EU's merger rules which ban creation or strengthening of dominant positions.

BA was given the go-ahead by a French court in January to buy the insolvent carrier in partnership with France's Banque Rivaud. The deal, if cleared by the EU, would give it more than 20 percent of the French air travel market.
The British airline has said that it might merge its existing French subsidiary TAT with Air Liberte, which went into receivership in 1996.

The proposed acquisition of Air Liberte was notified to the Commission on January 29. The Commission has one month from that date to clear the operation or start an in-depth, four month, probe if it is concerned about the impact on fair competition.
Separately, the Commission is also probing BA's alliance with AMR Corp's AMR American Airlines on which it was holding a hearing of all interested parties on Tuesday. Brussels newsroom 322 2876841
